description: When the server finished the create but the response was lost, a reload opens the new board, yet pending-create stays in sessionStorage. Later, Start or join a project shows "Launch plan Q1" pre-filled with "An earlier attempt to start “Launch plan Q1” didn't confirm. Starting it again resumes that attempt." for a project that already exists and is listed in the switcher.
expected: pending-create is cleared once the session lists a project created by that attempt (or the notice says "Launch plan Q1 was created").
actual: Stale notice and pre-filled name; resubmitting is harmless (same project returned) but the user is told something failed.
suggested_fix: After loading the session, resolve pending-create by re-sending it silently or clearing it when a matching project exists.

description: The failure stacks three messages: the resume notice, "The local Pardner client did not respond. Check that it is still running, then retry." and "Your local Pardner client may have stopped. Ask your agent to reopen it, then retry." The last two say the same thing.
expected: One failure message and one instruction; the resume notice can carry the retry advice.
actual: Three blocks of text around one Start button.
suggested_fix: Drop the JOIN_HINTS line for CLIENT_UNREACHABLE on Start, or merge the two sentences.

description: Editing the name after an unconfirmed attempt mints a new operation ID; when the first attempt had actually completed, the retry creates a second project ("Hiring plan" and "Hiring plan (v2)"). The notice keeps naming the old attempt while the field shows the new name. The CLI without --operation-id also creates duplicates silently (two "Launch plan CLI").
expected: After an unconfirmed attempt, the app first checks whether it completed before starting a differently named project; the CLI warns or requires --operation-id.
suggested_fix: Resolve the pending attempt before allowing a new one; make --operation-id required for client create.
